Executive Summary

Revenue grew 12% year-over-year, driven by strong performance in the US and EU markets. APAC showed slight contraction due to seasonal factors.

Key Findings

The US market contributed $1.5M in Q1, up from $1.3M in the prior year. EU markets showed steady growth at 8.3%.

Recommendations

Increase investment in APAC marketing to reverse the contraction trend. Consider expanding the EU sales team to capitalize on growth momentum.
